e.data_only_approximation: All stored Feather count is compressed into one chosen-direction return line; persistent map entities are not claimed.

r.untargetability_approximation: 100% basic/skill damage reduction plus crowd-control immunity; the entity remains present.

ground_feather_limit.reason: Mod API 0.8 cannot name-address or remove a projectile from another action. Q and R therefore leave bounded, damage-free endpoint visuals; E still uses the caster Feather counter and never recalls the marker entities themselves.

ai_bladecaller_gate.blocked_input: built-in AI Skill2 only; manual input is outside ModPlayerInputAi
ai_bladecaller_gate.unit_key: EntityHandle plus player id, team and position
ai_bladecaller_gate.cleanup: expired unit states are removed on Native-effect updates and AI reads; E clear removes the matching unit state
ai_bladecaller_gate.limitation: Mod API 0.8 exposes neither running_id nor the current EntityHandle on PlayerAiContext, so the AI lookup uses player/team/position plus current tick to select the newest live unit state and does not claim strict running-id isolation.

actor_scale.policy: uniform per-frame scaling only; no horizontal compression; native-width-limited poses keep the complete silhouette

bp_presentation.illustration_route: post-render NinePatch replacement using the dancer-specific side-card geometry contract
bp_presentation.grid_safety: The 54x94 center-grid actor is rejected by the side-card 81x125-141 contract and edge gate, then center-preservingly expanded to the dedicated 90x122 portrait so the texture is not horizontally squeezed.
bp_presentation.center_alignment: The stable 81x141 side actor shares the standard 137x184 actor center, so candidate scoring locks the splash to the same card slot.
bp_presentation.label_safety: center.y=-12 keeps the rebuilt native-height full-body preview clear of the name band; face.y=-32 gives compact rows a head-focused crop without a second upward over-shift.
